sentences.text: No: for a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions for Tier 4 UCBs were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

The bank’s own policy text says foreclosure means pre-payment of the loan in full, and another loan agreement says a borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, but those bank-document terms do not override the in-force UCB directions cited above.
